about: The model Part 1 (23–24 Nov 2026), written with the owner to the school's pattern: React (emotional) → Respond (factual) → Develop (one reason OR one example, never both) → Contrast. Set in Funchal, where most pupils live. Two levels, as real pairs are: Beatriz gives the SAFE answer (three stages, basic frames: what most pupils will say), Tomás the STRONGER one (four stages, varied frames). Never 'weak' in the app.

stages.t: My city? Oh, I love it! I find Funchal very beautiful.
What I like most about it is that it's right next to the sea.
Especially in the evenings, when my friends and I walk along the seafront.
Although it has become more crowded with tourists, it still feels like home.

turns.q: Where's the best place to go with friends in your city?

stages.t: Oh, I love the Lido.
The thing I love about it is the swimming pool.
Especially in summer, when it's very hot.

turns.q: Do you travel far every day?

stages.t: Far? Oh yes, quite far, unfortunately!
The thing is, I live up in Monte, but my school is in the centre.
For example, yesterday the bus took forty minutes!
However, I've become more used to it, and now I just listen to music on the way.

turns.q: Is there anything you'd change about your city?

stages.t: Hmm, let me think… I'd like better buses.
The thing is, they're often late.
Mainly because there aren't enough drivers.

turns.q: Do you prefer going by car or by public transport?

stages.t: To be honest, I'm not a big fan of buses, so I prefer the car.
The thing I love about it is that it's much faster.
Especially on Saturdays, when my dad drives me to football training.
The only problem is that it's worse for the environment.

turns.q: How much time do you spend listening to music?

stages.t: Oh, I love music!
I listen to it every day, for about two hours.
Mainly because it helps me relax.

intro.t: Good afternoon. My name's Maya. And your names are?
Thank you. First of all, we'd like to know something about you.
